derive.description: Copy it into a workspace, or save its shape as a template.
derive.duplicateBody: The roster, per-teammate settings and task list come across. The copy starts idle with no run history.
derive.templateBody: A template keeps the roster shape and squad settings. It does not keep the lead's own configuration, the task list, or anything a run produced.
derive.title: Reuse this squad

detail.dangerDescription: Conversations bound to it fall back to a single agent. Past runs are kept.
detail.deleteBody: This removes the Squad and its members. Runs it has already produced stay in the run history.
detail.missingDescription: It was deleted, perhaps in another window. Pick another from the list.
detail.noMembersDescription: Add teammates from a template, or from the Squad's own run surface.

nav.noSquads: No Squads yet. Start from a template, or create one.
